title: You're going to be okay (ORIGINAL)
description: No sooner had you asked for her, than she'd arrived, blankets in tow. You knew you can always give your best friend Shibs a call to come over, especially when you're not feeling well, and today was no exception. Only this time she'd come very well prepared. In what seemed like no time at all, she'd got you snuggly wrapped up in your chair, drinking a glass of cold refreshing water... * * * "You know... I've been practicing hypnosis in my spare time. And I think that I've gotten rather good at it... Maybe I can help you, by hypnotising you? You know there is a lot going on right now. Maybe taking a step out of your mind, and clearing your head of any and all of that stress and anxiety might be helpful. It's going to be okay... I'm here with you right now, and there is nowhere else I would rather be."
author: Mistress Shibby
